description: A single filled area whose points are joined by straight lines instead of a curve.
overview: The same one-series area as the default chart, with `type="linear"` so each month connects to the next with a straight segment. It has a month axis, a dashed grid and a tooltip with a line indicator.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Set the label and color of the series in `chartConfig`. The component takes no props.
